_title: Brief 5 item 4 — ground-cover coverage of reference imagery (colour-heuristic ESTIMATE)

_tool_state.measure_concept_look: scripts/measure_concept_look.py measures sky/skyline/water/palette/haze/grade only; it does NOT produce a grass/rock/litter/bare ground-cover fraction (see its docstring lines 10-28 and measure_* functions). Its argparse (lines 341-345) accepts only `image` and `--out` — there is NO --selftest and NO selftest function. `python scripts/measure_concept_look.py --selftest` prints usage and errors 'the following arguments are required: image'. So its selftest state is: NONE / not present.
_tool_state.chosen_path: Task option (ii): a separate, self-tested colour-heuristic estimator (scratchpad/estimate_groundcover.py, not committed). Its --selftest PASSES on a synthetic 40/20/20/20 grass/rock/litter/bare swatch (exact hit within 0.02).

_method.instrument: colour-heuristic ESTIMATE, NOT semantic segmentation and NOT a metric distance band. sRGB [0,1] per-pixel, deterministic, mutually-exclusive bins summing to 1.0 over the stated crop.
rules_in_order: grass  = vegetation/ground-cover: g >= 0.90*r AND (g-b) > 0.03 AND value > 0.10 (captures green and yellow-green dry heath)
litter = dark clutter/deep shadow: value < 0.16 (evaluated only on non-grass pixels)
bare   = warm brown/tan remainder: everything else (bare soil AND brown leaf-litter land here)
_method.selftest: PASS — synthetic 40% green / 20% grey / 20% dark / 20% tan returns grass 0.40, rock 0.20, litter 0.20, bare 0.20 (n=10000).
_method.band_handling: No image carries camera intrinsics or a depth pass, so the 1-30 m band cannot be isolated by distance. For ground-level shots the band is APPROXIMATED by the bottom 45% of the frame (nearest ground for a downward/level camera); band_established is false for every image. Aerial vistas have no near ground in frame at all -> band_m recorded null.

_limitations: BIOME MISMATCH — the desk MUST NOT read alpine-meadow targets off the ElectricDreams or CitySample rows. Only refs/alpine_village_01/02 are the project's alpine target. ElectricDreams PCG shots are temperate FOREST floor/canopy (different biome); CitySample is URBAN hardscape (near-zero grass, included only as a contrast anchor).

GRASS UNDERCOUNT IN BRIGHT/GOLDEN LIGHT — concept_01's sunlit hazy meadow largely fails the g>=0.90*r knife-edge: golden dry grass leaks into `bare`, and bright low-saturation backlit grass leaks into `rock`. Sensitivity on the concept_01 meadow rect: grass = 0.402 at g>=0.90*r, 0.487 at 0.85, ~0.50 at 0.80 (plateau). True vegetated ground-cover there is bounded roughly [0.40 (reported grass) .. ~0.90 (grass+bare+rock minus true stone)]; the split is unreliable in this lighting. Treat concept_01 grass as a LOWER BOUND.

LITTER vs BARE not separable by colour — brown LEAF-LITTER is warm and lands in `bare`, not `litter`. The `litter` bin here == dark/shadowed clutter and is conflated with cast shadow. For a 'non-vegetated ground' figure, combine bare+litter.
ROCK vs BARE is neutrality-vs-warmth only — grey-brown dirt or warm sandstone crosses the line (e.g. ED mid_distance's tan rock face reads as `bare`, not `rock`).

CROP CONTAMINATION — the bottom-45% crop of the concepts includes buildings, woodpiles and tree trunks (not ground); these read mostly as bare/rock and inflate those bins. The concept_01 meadow rect avoids the village and is the cleaner alpine-meadow read.
ANGULAR SCALE UNKNOWN for every image (no intrinsics); all crops are spatial proxies, never metric distance bands.
